confirmedFindings.title: Prototype pollution vulnerability in recursive object deep merge
confirmedFindings.body: Recursive deep merge does not sanitize sensitive object property keys (__proto__, constructor, prototype), allowing malicious property injection into Object.prototype.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Filter out keys matching __proto__, constructor, or prototype before recursive traversal.
